{{Quote|Anakin. Were you able to contact Master Luminara?''"<br />"''Yes, Master. She's busy with a fleet of Separatist reinforcements nearby. She won't be able to give us support until she's turned them away.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />}}
A '''battle''' took place near the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Senior Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] engaged [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] reinforcements that had been dispatched to aid the Confederate [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], which had suffered damage after a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|assault]] nearby the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]]. Unduli and her [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] were able to successfully dispatch her opponents.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Our bombers will attack at high speed to avoid the enemy's ion weapon. We'll concentrate our firepower on the bridge superstructure, here. We destroy Grievous, we can bring the war to a quicker end.|Anakin Skywalker briefs Shadow Squadron on a plan to counterattack the ''Malevolence''|audio=BringWarToQuickerEnd-SoM.flac|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />}}
[[File:Malevolencehit.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Malevolence''{{'s}} ion pulse cannons explode during the Battle of the Kaliida Nebula.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="FF-2014 24: Malevolence" /> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Malevolence Campaign/Legends|planned an assault]] on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] with the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] known as [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]]. Meanwhile, the Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] ordered [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]&mdash;the commander of the ''Malevolence''&mdash;to target the Republic's secret [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|medical center]], which was located near the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] and was treating over 60,000 wounded Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

Skywalker and Shadow Squadron were able to [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|intercept]] the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] before it could destroy the medical base. Damage to the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} massive [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]] caused them to explode, inflicting further damage to the [[Starship/Legends|warship]]. Several Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] arrived under the command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], and the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] initiated an assault on the ''Malevolence''. Unable to retreat to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] because of damage to the warship's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]],<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> Grievous was forced to call in reinforcements.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />

==The battle==
A Confederate [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was dispatched to aid the fleeing ''Malevolence'' and prevent the warship's destruction at the hands of the Republic [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] forces. However, [[Senior Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] intercepted the Confederate armada<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" /> with a fleet of her own<ref name="FF-2014 54: Unduli" /> and engaged the enemy fleet in battle. Skywalker contacted Unduli, seeking reinforcements for the continued attack on the ''Malevolence''. Unduli informed Skywalker of her situation, but despite her inability to provide immediate assistance to comrade, she still planned to help his forces once she had dispatched her opponents.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" /> Unduli was later able to defeat the Confederate reinforcements.<ref name="Victory?" />

==Aftermath==
{{Dialogue|Unduli|Another bold strategy by Skywalker, I presume?|Tano|That's my Master.|Koon|Once they make it off that ship, we'll need reinforcements to finish off the enemy.|Unduli|I'm on my way, Master Plo.|attr=Luminara Unduli reports to Plo Koon and Ahsoka Tano that she is on her way|src=<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />}}
[[File:Luminara_holo.png|thumb|right|250px|Unduli promises her support to Koon and Tano.]]
During the course of the Republic's attack on the ''Malevolence'', [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was tricked into traveling to the battlefield.<ref name="Agenda">''[[The Clone Wars: Agenda]]''</ref> Upon her arrival, she was pulled aboard the ''Malevolence'', as Grievous intended to use her as a hostage to guarantee his and the warship's escape. Skywalker and Kenobi boarded the ''Malevolence'' to rescue Amidala, while [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]&mdash;who had accompanied Skywalker and Shadow Squadron to the nebula&mdash;contacted Unduli via [[Hologram/Legends|holotransmission]] for support against the ''Malevolence''. Once Amidala had been rescued, Koon's fleet would need reinforcements to destroy the Confederate warship. Unduli promised her support, heading over to the nearby Republic armada. Skywalker was able to sabotage the warship's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]], and he escaped the warship with Kenobi and Amidala. Before Unduli arrived with her reinforcements, the ''Malevolence'' attempted to jump to hyperspace, and Skywalker's [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] caused the warship to crash into a [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|nearby moon]].<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle near the Kaliida Nebula was first mentioned in "[[Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence'']]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series that aired on [[October 17]], [[2008]].<ref name="Destroy Malevolence Ep Guide" />
